integrity: The proof derives the commutator coordinate equation exactly, reduces commuting-pair counting to a q^2-color Potts sum, and converts it to the spanning-subgraph/Tutte form. An exhaustive replay checks several small quivers and the Kronecker specialization.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for split basic algebras F_q Q/J^2 with finite loopless quiver Q; nonsplit radical-square-zero algebras are not covered.
Only the zero commutator fiber is enumerated; prescribed nonzero fibers can retain target-support information.
An equivalent formula may exist under bilinear-map, isoclinism, Potts, or random-cluster terminology.
title: Tutte-polynomial formula for commuting probabilities of radical-square-zero quiver algebras
